contractTypes.defaultNonStandard: Default new contracts to Non-Standard classification

next.submit: Next: submit for approval — a colleague with the Submit permission must submit it. The creator cannot submit their own contract.
next.approvals: Next: approvals — assigned approvers decide in order. The creator cannot approve their own contract.
next.execute: Next: execute — someone with the Execute permission can sign in Tellara, send via DocuSign, or record a manual execution.
next.signatures: Next: finalize signatures — awaiting signers, then the contract is executed.

obligations.title: Obligations & Renewals
obligations.empty: No obligations tracked. Add renewal deadlines and key milestones to get automated alerts.
obligations.newSubtitle: Track a renewal deadline, milestone, or recurring requirement
obligations.descriptionHint: Help the team understand what action is required and why

ownerGate.how: The selected Contract Owner starts MoA with the Submit permission; the creator cannot own or start their own contract.
ownerGate.title: Contract Owner approval
ownerGate.strictOrder: The Contract Owner starts the flow. MoA steps are approved strictly in order.
ownerGate.creatorHint: You created this contract, so you cannot be its owner or start MoA. The selected Contract Owner must review it.
ownerGate.onlyOwnerHint: Only the selected Contract Owner can review this contract and start MoA.
ownerGate.ownerPermissionHint: You are the Contract Owner. Your role also needs the Submit Contract permission to start MoA.
ownerGate.ownerCannotDecide: You started this contract's MoA workflow as Contract Owner, so another assigned approver must decide this step.

how.title: How contract approval works
how.create: Create and edit the draft using the Create/Edit permission.
how.submit: Submit for approval is done by a different colleague with the Submit permission; the creator cannot submit their own contract.
how.chain: On submit, the approval chain is generated automatically from MoA rules, or built manually if no rule matches.
how.approvers: Approvers decide each step in order. The creator cannot approve their own contract.
how.execute: Once approved, someone with Execute permission executes it in Tellara, via DocuSign, or by recording manual execution.

submit.title: Submit for approval
submit.generatedOnSubmit: The approval steps for this rule are generated when the contract is submitted.
submit.strictOrder: Approved strictly in order; the creator cannot approve their own contract.
submit.progression: Progression is non-bypassable. Earlier steps must be decided first.

statusManagedByWorkflow: Status changes through permitted approval, execution, renewal, termination, or archive actions.

workflowUi.decisionCommentPlaceholder: Decision comment (required for rejection or escalation)…
workflowUi.escalateHint: Use only if you cannot decide this step (wrong assignee, conflict of interest, or unavailable approver). A Contract Manager will reassign the step.

actions.renewConfirmDescription: The contract will be marked renewed as of today.
actions.archiveConfirmDescription: The contract will become a read-only historical record.
actions.deleteConfirmDescription: This contract will be soft-deleted (retained for audit) and hidden from the repository. This action cannot be undone.

validation.atLeastOneStep: Add at least one approval step.
validation.missingApprover: Every step must be assigned to exactly one user or one role.
validation.exclusiveStepType: A step cannot be both Legal Review and Execution.
validation.singleExecutionStep: A rule may contain only one Execution step.
validation.missingLegalReview: A non-standard contract rule must contain a Legal Review step.

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: No documents attached. Upload drafts, executed agreements, and amendments - they're OCR-processed and made searchable automatically.
